script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Romance
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: REUNION ROAD

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

JULIA, a thirty-something woman with a warm smile and a gentle demeanor, sits at a table, sipping on a cup of coffee. She gazes out the window, lost in thought. Suddenly, a pair of FAMILIAR GLASSES approaches from behind, catching her off guard. She turns to see JASON, an old flame from her past.

JASON
(surprised)
Julia? Is it really you?

JULIA
(startled)
Jason? I can't believe it! It's been what, 15 years?

JASON
Yes, time flies when you're living life. I'm so glad we ran into each other.

They share an awkward moment of silence before Julia recovers.

JULIA
So, what brings you back to town?

JASON
I got a job offer. I'll be starting as the new CEO at the tech company next week.

JULIA
That's amazing, Jason. Congratulations.

JASON
Thanks. But I can't help feeling a sense of nostalgia, being back here. Do you remember our old hangouts? The park, the diner, that one treehouse we used to build?

JULIA
(smiling)
Of course. Those were some good times.

Jason hesitates, then leans in closer.

JASON
You know what I've been thinking, Julia?

JULIA
(nervously)
What's that?

JASON
I've been thinking that maybe... maybe we should give this thing another try. I know we had our differences in the past, but I can't help feeling that there's something special about you.

JULIA
(hesitant)
Jason, I'm not the same person I was back then. I've grown, I've changed. I don't know if we could make it work.

JASON
But I have, too. And I believe that we can. I'd like to take you out for dinner, maybe catch a movie. What do you say?

JULIA
(pauses, then nods)
Okay. I'll give it a try.

INT. JULIA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Julia sits on her couch, looking at a photograph of her and Jason from their past. She wonders if this was a mistake, giving him another chance. She hears a knock at the door and stands up, opening it to reveal Jason, holding a bouquet of roses.

JASON
(smiling)
I brought these for you. I know it's only been one date, but I want you to know that I'm serious about us.

JULIA
(surprised, touched)
Thank you, Jason. I'm glad you're back in my life.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

Julia and Jason sit across from each other at a table in a cozy restaurant. They laugh and share stories about their past, discussing their dreams and goals for the future.

JULIA
(smiling)
I'm so glad we're giving this another chance, Jason. It feels like we've picked up right where we left off.

JASON
(nods)
I know what you mean. I've always had a feeling that we were meant to be together.

They share a heartfelt moment, their eyes locked in a loving gaze.

EXT. PARK - DAY

Julia and Jason sit on a bench in the park, watching as children play on the swings and the sun sets in the distance.

JULIA
(leaning her head on Jason's shoulder)
I'm so glad we found our way back to each other. It's like everything has fallen into place.

JASON
(gently stroking her hair)
I agree, Julia. I think we're meant to be together. And I plan on making every moment count.

They share a tender kiss as the sun sets, their second chance at love beginning anew.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
